officers.bio: Records and distributes meeting minutes, maintains official records and attendance, preps agendas, manages chapter social media, and handles official correspondence.

officers.name: Kye Livezey
officers.bio: Leads the PD Committee — runs the speaker series, UFTR tours, and workshops, tracks attendance and engagement, and represents PD at Executive Board meetings.

officers.name: Leah Dixel
